newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Transaero to lease two Boeing 737s for two months.
newsitem.headline: Transaero to lease two Boeing 737s for two months.

text.p: Private Russian carrier Transaero will lease two Boeing 737 passenger jets for two months from Yugoslavia's Aviojenex, a Transaero spokeswoman said on Thursday.
Natalya Alexashina told Reuters Transaero would operate the aircraft from late October on regular domestic and international flights.
"We have began six new international and domestic routes this year and we need more planes to service them," Alexashina said.
At present the airline operates 14 aircraft -- five Boeing 757s, five 737s, three DC-10-30s and one widebody Ilyushin Il-86. Thirteen of the planes are leased.
